startDate.description: Date when the scan should start, in MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm format

assessmentTypeId.description: The assessment type id to use for the scan. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/releases/{releaseId}/assessment-types

entitlementId.description: The entitlement id to consume for the scan

entitlementFrequencyType.description: The entitlement frequency type to use for the scan

isRemediationScan.description: Indicates if the scan is a remediation scan. If not supplied the default value is false

isBundledAssessment.description: Indicates if the assessment is a bundled assessment. If not supplied legacy behavior will apply

parentAssessmentTypeId.description: The parent assessment type id for the bundled assessment. If not supplied legacy behavior will apply

applyPreviousScanSettings.description: Indicates if the previous scan settings should be applied to the remediation scan. This value is ignored if isRemediationScan = false. If not supplied the default value is false.

scanMethodType.description: The method of starting a scan

scanToolVersion.description: The version for the scan tool used for scanning
